API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Feeds Resource Get All NSS Feeds
NSS Feeds Resource Get All NSS Feeds
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssFeeds

Retrieves the cloud NSS feeds configured in the ZIA Admin Portal

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
feedType
string

Possible values: [QRADAR, SYSLOG, CSV, TAB_SEPARATED, CUSTOM, SPLUNK_CIM, NAME_VALUE_PAIRS, RSA_SECURITY, ARCSIGHT_CEF, SYMANTEC_MSS, LOGRHYTHM, ZBRIDGE, MCAS, JSON, ZFAB_AGENT]

The cloud NSS feed type

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier of the cloud NSS feed

name
string

The name of the cloud NSS feed

feedStatus
string

The status of the feed

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]

nssLogType
string

The type of NSS logs that are streamed (e.g. Web, Firewall, DNS, Alert, etc.)

Possible values: [ADMIN_AUDIT, WEBLOG, ALERT, FWLOG, DNSLOG, MULTIFEEDLOG, CASB_FILELOG, CASB_MAILLOG, ECLOG, EC_DNSLOG, CASB_ITSM, CASB_CRM, CASB_CODE_REPO, CASB_COLLAB, CASB_PCS, USER_ACT_REP, USER_COUNT_ALERT, USER_IMP_TRAVEL_ALERT, ENDPOINT_DLP, EC_EVENTLOG, EMAIL_DLP]

nssFeedType
string

NSS feed format type (e.g. CSV, syslog, Splunk Common Information Model (CIM), etc.

Possible values: [QRADAR, SYSLOG, CSV, TAB_SEPARATED, CUSTOM, SPLUNK_CIM, NAME_VALUE_PAIRS, RSA_SECURITY, ARCSIGHT_CEF, SYMANTEC_MSS, LOGRHYTHM, ZBRIDGE, MCAS, JSON, ZFAB_AGENT]

feedOutputFormat
string

Output format used for the feed

userObfuscation
string

Specifies whether user obfuscation is enabled or disabled

Possible values: [ENABLED, DISABLED]

timeZone
string

Specifies the time zone that must be used in the output file

Possible values: [NOT_SPECIFIED, GMT_12_00_DATELINE, GMT_11_00_SAMOA, GMT_10_00_US_HAWAIIAN_TIME, GMT_09_30_MARQUESAS, GMT_09_00_US_ALASKA_TIME, GMT_08_30_PITCARN, GMT_08_00_PACIFIC_TIME, customDownloadFiletype
string[]

Filter to limit logs based on the downloaded during the transaction. To obtain the list of custom file types, use GET /customFileTypes.

customUploadFiletype
string[]

Filter to limit logs based on the uploaded during the transaction. To obtain the list of custom file types, use GET /customFileTypes.
